subject.title: member-info fails with "fetch failed" on WSL2 in 2026.6.1 (SSRF fetch guard / undici dispatcher regression)

question: How should Teams Graph requests behave on WSL2 when native fetch succeeds but the SSRF-pinned Undici dispatcher fails?
rationale: Changing or bypassing `fetchWithSsrFGuard` affects OpenClaw's SSRF boundary, so a maintainer/security owner should choose the acceptable transport behavior after live proof.

options.title: Fix guarded transport after live repro
options.body: Keep Teams Graph on the SSRF guard, capture a live WSL2 failure, and adjust the pinned dispatcher or shared transport policy only as narrowly as that proof supports.

options.title: Add explicit operator opt-in
options.body: If WSL2 needs a less strict transport path, make it an explicit documented setting with security warnings and tests instead of changing the default silently.

options.title: Keep blocked until more proof
options.body: Leave the issue open with needs-live-repro if maintainers cannot obtain a redacted WSL2 Teams Graph run yet.

recommendation.title: Fix guarded transport after live repro
recommendation.body: Keep Teams Graph on the SSRF guard, capture a live WSL2 failure, and adjust the pinned dispatcher or shared transport policy only as narrowly as that proof supports.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on adjacent SSRF dispatcher and WSL2 transport diagnostics.
